## About me

![Own figure.](/shared/figures/martin-timeline.webp){fig-alt="A horizontal career timeline. 2007: Bioinformatics studies, Friedrich Schiller University Jena. 2012: Diploma with Prof. Sebastian Böcker on computational mass spectrometry. 2013: PhD student with Prof. Manja Marz, RNA Bioinformatics and High-Throughput Analysis. 2017: Postdoc, thesis 'The Dark Art of Next-Generation Sequencing'. 2018: Team leader, hoelzer-lab.github.io. 2019: Co-founder of nanozoo, bioinformatics and cloud computing; visiting researcher with Dr. Rob Finn at the European Bioinformatics Institute, UK. 2020: Researcher and team lead, Genome Competence Center, 'Bioinformatics and Translational Research'."}
